Your argument that `eth_getTransactionByHash` is changing soon is also compelling, as that is another piece that I think we need to exercise in our "example". excerpts.content: Your first reason is explicitly the reason I like `eth_call` as the example, it will force us to deal with cross-client inconsistencies and thus allow us to show the full path.  Your argument that `eth_getTransactionByHash` is changing soon is also compelling, as that is another piece that I think we need to exercise in our "example".
